route_lips_tilt_worst.formula: route (c) shape, 2.0 mm 5052-H32 + two 12 mm lips: bracket tilt, design load, WORST revision (Rev A or Rev B, motor at the far end)

route_lips_margin_worst.formula: route (c) shape, 2.0 mm 5052-H32 + two 12 mm lips: tilt_limit - tilt_worst (bracket only): use in Ep 06/07/23 tables

route_lips_margin_worst_pct.formula: route (c) shape, 2.0 mm 5052-H32 + two 12 mm lips: margin_worst as % of tilt_limit

route_lips_sys_margin_worst.formula: route (c) shape, 2.0 mm 5052-H32 + two 12 mm lips: tilt_limit - (tilt_worst + tilt_shaft_est) x F_max/F_design: left for assembly misalignment, worst revision
route_lips_sys_margin_worst.spoken: zero point zero zero four degrees

route_lips_sys_margin_worst_pct.formula: route (c) shape, 2.0 mm 5052-H32 + two 12 mm lips: sys_margin_worst as % of tilt_limit

route_lips_I.formula: composite rectangles: web B_motor x t + 2 lips t x (H_lip - t); sum(b h^3/12 + A d^2) (gross; in the slot zone the web is reduced by the cut-outs)
route_lips_I.spoken: one thousand four hundred and forty-three millimetres to the fourth

route_lips_s_bar.formula: neutral axis from the motor seat face = sum(A s)/sum(A)

route_lips_I_ratio_same_web.formula: route_lips_I / (B_motor t^3 / 12): lips vs a flat flange of the same 58 mm width (shape alone; D156)

route_lips_corner_pct.formula: share of the lipped tilt from the unlipped corner (the next weak spring)

route_lips_mass_pct.formula: extra blank area for the lip ears vs the flat 2.0 mm blank

route_lips_process.value: 3 bends; lips first, then the main bend with segmented tooling

mass_steel_g.formula: (flat_rel x b - holes and slots, Rev A) x t_steel x rho_steel (released part)

mass_al_g.formula: flat 2.0 mm 5052 blank of the same outline (aluminium concept)

mass_ratio_rel.formula: mass_steel_g / mass_al_g: released steel part vs the 2.0 mm aluminium concept

FOS_netreal_steel.formula: Sy_steel_min / (6M / (b_net_real t^2)), real worst cut-out line, Rev A

FOS_netreal_steel_revB.formula: same on the Rev B worst line (b_net_real_revB)

sigma_mount_holes.formula: 6 M_heel / ((b - 2 x hole) t^2): mounting flange through the two M5 holes

FOS_min_steel.formula: smallest FOS of the steel bracket on the specified minimum yield Sy_steel_min (bend, lumped net, real lines Rev A/B, M5 hole section)

strength_check_steel.formula: every section FOS >= FOS_gate (PDS R4), Rev A and Rev B, specified minimum yield

FOS_min_steel_typ.formula: information (Ep 07 comparison only): FOS_min_steel on the TYPICAL yield Sy_steel

FOS_min_steel_dc01.formula: information: FOS_min_steel if a DC01 lot were only at Sy_steel_dc01_design (no specified minimum in EN 10130)

theta_mount_steel.formula: M_heel (L1 - c) / (4 E_steel I), c = t + R: mounting flange propped by the end face (gross section; upper bound, conservative)

theta_bend_steel.formula: M_heel (pi/2)(R + t/2) / (E_steel I): bend zone (gross section)

theta_motor_steel.formula: M x integral(dx / (E_steel I(x))) from c to L_near_row: motor flange, gross section elsewhere, net section in slot zone

slot_zone_start.formula: first line across the motor flange that cuts a slot (= near M3 slot end, hb_slot_edge): the slot zone runs from here to the near screw row

tilt_gross_steel.formula: information: the same tilt with the slots ignored (gross section everywhere, the previous model), Rev A
tilt_gross_steel.spoken: zero point zero nine four degrees

tilt_gross_steel_revB.spoken: zero point zero nine nine degrees

tilt_slot_pct.formula: tilt_steel_revB / tilt_gross_steel_revB - 1: what the slot zone adds (Rev B, worst)

tilt_mount_steel.spoken: zero point zero one two degrees

tilt_bend_steel.spoken: zero point zero one nine degrees

tilt_motor_steel.spoken: zero point zero seven two degrees

tilt_steel.formula: PDS R11 value: shaft tilt from the steel bracket, design load, motor at the far end (Rev A); simplified model, errs both ways: gross section elsewhere, net section in slot zone; mounting term upper bound (conservative); motor and screws rigid (non-conservative); confirm by test (PDS R11)

tilt_steel_revB.formula: same, Rev B far end (longer slots, longer slot zone)

move_steel.formula: PDS R5 value: tilt (rad) x (p + c), Rev A; simplified model, errs both ways: gross section elsewhere, net section in slot zone; mounting term upper bound (conservative); motor and screws rigid (non-conservative); confirm by test (PDS R11)

tilt_sys_work_steel.formula: (worst tilt_steel + tilt_shaft_est) x F_max / F_design: bracket + motor shaft at the working load, before assembly misalignment
tilt_sys_work_steel.spoken: zero point one six two degrees

tilt_sys_margin_steel.formula: tilt_guide - tilt_sys_work_steel: left for every static misalignment, including the as-made bend angle, motor face and pulleys (Rev B, worst) = misalign_budget; met by setting each pulley and each belt clamp to the rail at assembly (asm_alignment_step)
tilt_sys_margin_steel.spoken: zero point zero eight eight degrees

tilt_sys_design_steel.formula: bracket + motor shaft at the design load (information; below the guidance even at the design load)

tilt_check_steel.formula: PDS R11: tilt_steel and tilt_steel_revB <= tilt_limit

stiff_check_steel.formula: PDS R5: move_steel and move_steel_revB <= move_limit

side_steel.formula: tilt (rad) x (a + T/2): sideways shift along the shaft, information (speak only with the tilt)

sigma_netreal_steel.formula: 6M / (b_net_real t^2): nominal stress on the worst real cut-out line, released 2.5 mm steel, Rev A (the value behind FOS_netreal_steel)

sigma_netreal_steel_revB.formula: 6M / (b_net_real_revB t^2): same, Rev B (the value behind FOS_netreal_steel_revB)

fea_tilt_lo_revA.formula: revA: (hand tilt - mounting-flange term) x (1 - fea_band_tol): lower end, an FEA that clamps the mounting flange removes the upper-bound term; information only: the gate stays the hand calculation (FOS, R5, R11) plus the R11 tilt test
fea_tilt_lo_revA.spoken: zero point zero eight three degrees

fea_tilt_hi_revA.formula: revA: hand tilt x (1 + fea_band_tol): upper end (the hand model is an upper bound except for the rigid-motor choice, which the FEA shares); information only: the gate stays the hand calculation (FOS, R5, R11) plus the R11 tilt test
fea_tilt_hi_revA.spoken: zero point one one four degrees

fea_move_lo_revA.formula: revA: pulley movement band, lower end, same factors as the tilt band; information only: the gate stays the hand calculation (FOS, R5, R11) plus the R11 tilt test
fea_move_lo_revA.spoken: zero point zero three six millimetres

fea_move_hi_revA.formula: revA: pulley movement band, upper end; information only: the gate stays the hand calculation (FOS, R5, R11) plus the R11 tilt test
fea_move_hi_revA.spoken: zero point zero four nine millimetres

fea_tilt_lo_revB.formula: revB: (hand tilt - mounting-flange term) x (1 - fea_band_tol): lower end, an FEA that clamps the mounting flange removes the upper-bound term; information only: the gate stays the hand calculation (FOS, R5, R11) plus the R11 tilt test
fea_tilt_lo_revB.spoken: zero point zero nine three degrees

fea_tilt_hi_revB.formula: revB: hand tilt x (1 + fea_band_tol): upper end (the hand model is an upper bound except for the rigid-motor choice, which the FEA shares); information only: the gate stays the hand calculation (FOS, R5, R11) plus the R11 tilt test
fea_tilt_hi_revB.spoken: zero point one two six degrees

fea_move_lo_revB.formula: revB: pulley movement band, lower end, same factors as the tilt band; information only: the gate stays the hand calculation (FOS, R5, R11) plus the R11 tilt test
fea_move_lo_revB.spoken: zero point zero four one millimetres

fea_move_hi_revB.formula: revB: pulley movement band, upper end; information only: the gate stays the hand calculation (FOS, R5, R11) plus the R11 tilt test
fea_move_hi_revB.spoken: zero point zero five five millimetres

x_clamp_edge.formula: revA: L_near_row - washer_M3_od/2: motor-clamp edge from datum A, the last line where M = F p still acts (FEA comparison line)

b_net_clamp_edge.formula: revA: b - real cut-out width on the clamp-edge line (pilot slot + M3 slots, full travel)

sigma_clampedge_steel.formula: revA: 6M / (b_net_clamp_edge t^2), released 2.5 mm steel: hand nominal stress on the clamp-edge line, compared with the FEA

fea_stress_lo_revA.formula: revA: sigma_clampedge_steel x (1 - fea_band_tol), i.e. -10 %, ends rounded inward: compare the FEA stress linearised (integrated) across the clamp-edge line; information only: the gate stays the hand calculation (FOS, R5, R11) plus the R11 tilt test

fea_stress_hi_revA.formula: revA: sigma_clampedge_steel x (1 + fea_band_tol), i.e. +10 %, ends rounded inward; information only: the gate stays the hand calculation (FOS, R5, R11) plus the R11 tilt test

fea_stress_reason_below_revA.formula: revA: sigma_netreal_steel (hand worst line, gate value): an FEA line stress below it shows the reason line (always, at the clamp edge)

x_clamp_edge_revB.formula: revB: L_near_row_revB - washer_M3_od/2: motor-clamp edge from datum A, the last line where M = F p still acts (FEA comparison line)

b_net_clamp_edge_revB.formula: revB: b - real cut-out width on the clamp-edge line (pilot slot + M3 slots, full travel)

sigma_clampedge_steel_revB.formula: revB: 6M / (b_net_clamp_edge t^2), released 2.5 mm steel: hand nominal stress on the clamp-edge line, compared with the FEA

fea_stress_lo_revB.formula: revB: sigma_clampedge_steel x (1 - fea_band_tol), i.e. -10 %, ends rounded inward: compare the FEA stress linearised (integrated) across the clamp-edge line; information only: the gate stays the hand calculation (FOS, R5, R11) plus the R11 tilt test

fea_stress_hi_revB.formula: revB: sigma_clampedge_steel x (1 + fea_band_tol), i.e. +10 %, ends rounded inward; information only: the gate stays the hand calculation (FOS, R5, R11) plus the R11 tilt test

fea_stress_reason_below_revB.formula: revB: sigma_netreal_steel_revB (hand worst line, gate value): an FEA line stress below it shows the reason line (always, at the clamp edge)

fea_stress_reason.value: Reason line: the clamped motor takes part of the moment at the screw row, so the FEA there sits below the hand worst-line value: that value is a safe upper bound.
fea_stress_reason.formula: REVIEW_F11_CAE finding 1 wording; shown when the FEA clamp-edge stress is below the hand worst-line value

x_fullM_line.formula: (c_rel + slot_zone_start) / 2: line in the full-moment zone with no cut-out, from datum A (Rev A = Rev B: the near slot end does not move)

sigma_fullM_line_steel.formula: 6M / (b t^2) on the full-moment line (gross section, full M = F p); same at Rev A and Rev B

fea_line2_lo_revA.formula: revA: sigma_fullM_line_steel x (1 - fea_band_tol), linearised across the line; close agreement expected; information only: the gate stays the hand calculation (FOS, R5, R11) plus the R11 tilt test

fea_line2_hi_revA.formula: revA: sigma_fullM_line_steel x (1 + fea_band_tol); information only: the gate stays the hand calculation (FOS, R5, R11) plus the R11 tilt test

fea_line2_lo_revB.formula: revB: sigma_fullM_line_steel x (1 - fea_band_tol), linearised across the line; close agreement expected; information only: the gate stays the hand calculation (FOS, R5, R11) plus the R11 tilt test

fea_line2_hi_revB.formula: revB: sigma_fullM_line_steel x (1 + fea_band_tol); information only: the gate stays the hand calculation (FOS, R5, R11) plus the R11 tilt test

sigma_bend_lin_steel.formula: 6M / (b t^2) in the bend zone = Sy_steel_min / FOS_bend_steel: compare the through-thickness linearised (membrane + bending) FEA stress

fea_bend_lo.formula: sigma_bend_lin_steel x (1 - fea_band_tol); information only: the gate stays the hand calculation (FOS, R5, R11) plus the R11 tilt test

fea_bend_hi.formula: sigma_bend_lin_steel x (1 + fea_band_tol); information only: the gate stays the hand calculation (FOS, R5, R11) plus the R11 tilt test

Ki_bend_inner.formula: curved-beam inner-fibre factor, rectangular section: (rn - ri) / (A e ri) over 6/(b t^2); rn = t / ln(ro/ri), e = rc - rn, ri = R, ro = R + t

sigma_bend_inner_steel.formula: sigma_bend_lin_steel x Ki_bend_inner: inner-fibre stress at the bend ("curved-beam effect"); information, not compared

x_slot_end_pilot.formula: near end of the pilot slot from datum A (a - T/2 - pilot_end_ext - pilot_slot/2); Rev A = Rev B

x_slot_end_m3.formula: near end of the near M3 slots from datum A (a - T/2 - m3_pat/2 - m3_slot/2); Rev A = Rev B

sigma_slotend_steel.formula: largest 6M / (b_net(x) t^2) on the near slot-end lines (x_slot_end_pilot, x_slot_end_m3): local nominal under the full moment (REVIEW_F11_CAE finding 6)

fea_peak_lo.formula: sigma_slotend_steel x 2: expected local peak at the slot ends, low end (Ep 06 stress raisers about 2-3x nominal); only after slot-end refinement converges; not a gate

fea_peak_hi.formula: sigma_slotend_steel x 3: expected local peak, high end; still below Sy_steel_min; not a gate

fea_mesh_limit_pct.formula: mesh study: the tilt must change by less than this at half element size

fea_tilt_revA.formula: input: FreeCAD FEM (CalculiX) result of ACT-103
fea_tilt_revA.spoken: zero point zero nine four degrees

fea_tilt_revB.formula: input placeholder: FreeCAD FEM (CalculiX) result of ACT-103, to be measured (filled after the run)

fea_stress_revA.formula: input: FreeCAD FEM (CalculiX) result of ACT-103

fea_stress_revB.formula: input placeholder: FreeCAD FEM (CalculiX) result of ACT-103, to be measured (filled after the run)

fea_peak.formula: input placeholder: FreeCAD FEM (CalculiX) result of ACT-103, to be measured (filled after the run)

fea_move_revA.formula: input: FreeCAD FEM (CalculiX) result of ACT-103
fea_move_revA.spoken: zero point zero four one millimetres

fea_move_revB.formula: input placeholder: FreeCAD FEM (CalculiX) result of ACT-103, to be measured (filled after the run)

fea_line2_revA.formula: input: FreeCAD FEM (CalculiX) result of ACT-103

fea_line2_revB.formula: input placeholder: FreeCAD FEM (CalculiX) result of ACT-103, to be measured (filled after the run)

fea_bend_lin.formula: input: FreeCAD FEM (CalculiX) result of ACT-103

fea_mesh_delta_pct.formula: input placeholder: FreeCAD FEM (CalculiX) result of ACT-103, to be measured (filled after the run)

fea_model_rev.formula: input placeholder: FreeCAD FEM (CalculiX) result of ACT-103, to be measured (filled after the run)

fea_verdict.formula: PENDING until every fea_* result (tilt, movement, clamp-edge line, full-moment line, bend linearised, peak, mesh delta, model rev) is filled; then AGREES if each is in its band, the peak in fea_peak_lo..hi (+/-20 %) and the mesh delta under fea_mesh_limit_pct, else CHECK MODEL (find out why; never retune the model; the gate stays the hand calculation and the R11 test)

fea_verdict_revA.formula: Rev A rows (tilt, movement, clamp-edge stress, full-moment line, bend linearised): AGREES if each FEA result is in its band (R2 compression-only support, REVIEW_F11_CAE R1/R2); fea_verdict (all rows, Rev B, peak, mesh) stays PENDING until those are filled

fea_stress_reason_show.formula: PENDING until filled; SHOW if a clamp-edge-line FEA stress is below fea_stress_reason_below (the reason line fea_stress_reason goes on screen)

shaft_ratio.formula: working shaft load / allowed radial load at the same distance

shaft_ratio_design.formula: design load / allowed radial load (rating is for bearing life: working load governs)

shaft_check.formula: working load <= allowed radial load, applied no farther out than the rated distance (p and shaft_load_distance both from the motor mounting face, course decision)

F_stall.formula: crash / stall at the end stop: T_motor_peak / r_pitch (slack span goes slack), not less than F_max

FOS_stall_bend.formula: Sy_steel_min / (6 F_stall p / (b t^2)), bend zone

FOS_stall_real.formula: Sy_steel_min on the worst real cut-out line (Rev A or B, the wider cut), F_stall

FOS_stall_mount.formula: Sy_steel_min / (6 F_stall (p + c) / ((b - 2 hole) t^2)), mounting flange through the M5 holes

stall_check.formula: min stall FOS (all sections) >= FOS_stall_gate (no yield)

shaft_ratio_stall.formula: F_stall / allowed radial load: above the continuous rating - ask the motor maker for the peak radial limit

tilt_stall.formula: worst tilt_steel x stall_ratio: elastic, while stalled only

sigma_range_work.formula: information: nominal stress range, 0 to working load, bend zone (gross section; not the worst line: see sigma_range_slot)

Se_steel_est.formula: 0.5 x Su_steel: rough unfactored endurance-limit estimate for steel (before surface, size and stress-raiser factors)

fatigue_ratio.formula: information: Se_steel_est / sigma_range_work, bend zone (Ep 06 S15 uses fatigue_ratio_slot)

sigma_range_slot.formula: worst nominal stress range, 0 to working load, on the worst real cut-out line (Rev B): 6 F_max p / (b_net_real_revB t^2); the slot ends are where cracks start (Ep 06 S15)

fatigue_ratio_slot.formula: Se_steel_est / sigma_range_slot: before stress-raiser (about 2-3) and surface factors; low risk, not formally checked (Ep 06 S15)

fatigue_ratio_slot_kt.formula: information: Se_steel_est / (sigma_range_slot x 3), the high end of the slot-end stress raiser, before the surface factor

bolt_T.formula: M_heel (y2 - c) / (2 ((L1 - c)^2 + (y2 - c)^2)), 2 bolts per row

pre_ratio.formula: preload / (proof strength x As), target up to about 0.75

torque.formula: K x preload x d (illustrative; confirm with a supplier table)

eng_M5.formula: L - grip - washer (M5 x 12 into the tapped ACT-101 end block)

engD_M5.spoken: one point seven times the diameter

eng_M3.formula: L - grip - washer at nominal (M3 x 6 + ISO 7089 washer into the SAMPLE 4.5 mm motor thread)

engD_M3.formula: eng_M3 / 3 mm at NOMINAL sheet, screw and washer: the 1D quick screen with no spare; the release check is at the tolerance corners (M3_check)

M3_stack.value: ISO 4762 M3 x 6 + ISO 7089 washer 3 (300 HV) under the head, through 2.5 ±0.12 mm sheet (before plating), into the SAMPLE motor thread (4.5 mm min)
M3_stack.formula: released motor-screw stack, checked at every tolerance corner

t_steel_min.formula: t_steel - t_tol: thinnest conforming sheet (bare, before plating)

t_steel_max.formula: t_steel + t_tol: thickest conforming sheet (bare, before plating)

grip_plating.formula: 2 x zinc_um_max: MAXIMUM plating on both sheet faces, added to the grip on the short-engagement side (worst corner)
grip_plating.spoken: zero point zero two four millimetres

drawing_t_note.value: SHEET THICKNESS 2.5 ±0.12 BEFORE PLATING (OVERRIDES THE GENERAL TOLERANCE; A MILL TOLERANCE WIDER THAN THIS NEEDS A WRITTEN DEVIATION)
drawing_t_note.formula: drawing note for ACT-103; title-block thickness field reads "2.5 (SEE NOTE n)"

eng_M3_min.formula: (L_M3 - L_M3_tol) - (t_steel_max + grip_plating) - (washer_M3 + washer_M3_tol): least engagement length of a conforming stack (gross)

eng_M3_max.formula: (L_M3 + L_M3_tol) - t_steel_min - (washer_M3 - washer_M3_tol): most engagement of a conforming stack

engD_M3_min.spoken: zero point eight six times the diameter

engD_M3_max.spoken: one point one four times the diameter

runout_M3_min.formula: depth_M3 - eng_M3_max: least thread left below the screw tip (rule >= 1, no bottoming)

runout_M3_margin.formula: runout_M3_min - 1 mm rule: the margin at the worst stacked corner (thin-sheet side; on the 1 mm rule, not on bottoming)

thread_ded_M3.formula: (thread_end_P + lead_in_P) x P: not full thread (screw end per ISO 4753 u <= 2P, plus the hole lead-in); deducted in the strip check

eng_M3_full_min.formula: eng_M3_min - thread_ded_M3: full-thread engagement at the short corner (strip-check basis)

A_strip_M3.formula: pi n d_min [1/(2n) + 0.57735 (d_min - D2_max)], n = 1/P: shear area of the internal thread per mm of FULL-thread engagement, least-material 6H/6g
A_strip_M3.spoken: five point five four seven square millimetres per millimetre

preload_M3_nom.formula: torque_M3 / (K d): preload from the SAMPLE assembly torque (= preload_M3)

preload_M3_max.formula: torque_M3 x (1 + torque_tol_pct) / (K_min d): most preload the assembly torque can give (top of torque tolerance, low K)
preload_M3_max.spoken: one thousand two hundred and twenty-two newtons

preload_M3_min.formula: torque_M3 x (1 - torque_tol_pct) / (1.25 K d): least preload (bottom of torque tolerance, K 25 % high; information for the slip check)

F_strip_M3_min.formula: tau_motor x A_strip_M3 x eng_M3_full_min: thread-strip force at the worst corner, full threads only
F_strip_M3_min.spoken: one thousand three hundred and eighty-seven newtons

FOS_strip_M3.formula: F_strip_M3_min / preload (unrounded), full threads only (screw end 2P + lead-in 0.5P deducted); rounded DOWN (as every FOS key); gate strip_gate

FOS_strip_M3_max.formula: F_strip_M3_min / preload_M3_max, full threads only (must stay above 1: no stripping at assembly)

FOS_strip_M3_1P.formula: information: strip FOS at the worst corner with only 1 pitch deducted

FOS_strip_M3_max_1P.formula: information: same at preload_M3_max, 1 pitch deducted

FOS_strip_M3_nom.formula: information: full-thread basis at nominal engagement

eng_M3_full_req.formula: max(strip_gate x preload_M3, preload_M3_max) / (tau_motor x A_strip_M3): full-thread engagement the strip check needs

eng_M3_req.formula: eng_M3_full_req + thread_ded_M3: least engagement length (gross) the strip check accepts

engD_M3_req.spoken: zero point eight two times the diameter

strip_check_M3.formula: FOS_strip_M3 >= strip_gate and FOS_strip_M3_max > 1 (worst corner, full threads only)

stack_t_lo.formula: thinnest bare sheet with run-out >= 1 at the longest screw and thinnest washer (bottoming side)

stack_t_hi.formula: thickest bare sheet that still passes the strip check (full threads) at the shortest screw, thickest washer, with plating
stack_t_hi.spoken: two point seven four nine millimetres

stack_t_margin_lo.formula: t_steel_min - stack_t_lo: room on the thin side

stack_t_margin_hi.formula: stack_t_hi - t_steel_max: room on the thick side

grip_plating_max.formula: same as grip_plating (the release stack uses the maximum plating)
grip_plating_max.spoken: zero point zero two four millimetres

FOS_strip_M3_zmax.formula: same as FOS_strip_M3 (maximum plating on the grip, release basis)

stack_t_hi_zmax.formula: same as stack_t_hi (maximum plating, release basis)
stack_t_hi_zmax.spoken: two point seven four nine millimetres

grip_plating_zmin.formula: information: 2 x zinc_um, plating at the minimum (the superseded basis)
grip_plating_zmin.spoken: zero point zero one six millimetres

eng_M3_min_zmin.formula: information: eng_M3_min at the minimum plating

engD_M3_min_zmin.formula: information: engD_M3_min at the minimum plating
engD_M3_min_zmin.spoken: zero point eight six times the diameter

F_strip_M3_min_zmin.formula: information: F_strip_M3_min at the minimum plating
F_strip_M3_min_zmin.spoken: one thousand three hundred and ninety-five newtons

FOS_strip_M3_zmin.formula: information: FOS_strip_M3 at the minimum plating (the superseded basis, 1.67)

stack_t_hi_zmin.formula: information: stack_t_hi at the minimum plating
stack_t_hi_zmin.spoken: two point seven five seven millimetres

stack_t_margin_hi_zmin.formula: information: stack_t_margin_hi at the minimum plating

ga12_max_measured_t_zmin.formula: information: bare-sheet 12 GA limit at the minimum plating (the superseded 2.75)

stack_grip_hi.formula: stack_t_hi + grip_plating: thickest sheet MEASURED OVER THE PLATING that passes every gate (independent of the actual plating thickness)
stack_grip_hi.spoken: two point seven seven three millimetres

M3_screen.formula: quick screen at nominal: >= 1D and run-out >= 1 (a failed screen calls for the corner check; it is not a reject)

M3_check.formula: release check at every tolerance corner: runout_M3_min >= 1 (no bottoming) and strip_check_M3 on full threads (motor maker data govern)

note_M3_judgement.value: M3 x 6 with an ISO 7089 washer through 2.5 ±0.12 mm sheet engages 0.86-1.14D across the tolerance band (1D at nominal), with at least 1.09 mm of thread below the tip; it is accepted on a thread-strip check of the full threads only at the worst corner (FOS 1.66 against 1.5, at the SAMPLE torque of 0.5 N·m; the motor maker's data govern), not on the 1D screen. M3 x 8 would bottom.

note_M3_rule.value: Our 1.5D rule is for tapped holes we design: it makes the screw, not the thread, the weak link at full screw strength. A bought motor's thread is the maker's design, so the maker's thread depth and screw torque govern; we check that its full threads carry the torque-limited preload (strip check) and that the screw cannot bottom, at every tolerance corner.
note_M3_rule.formula: how the course reconciles a motor maker's tapped holes with the 1.5D rule

note_K_strip.value: K scatter: at the same 0.5 N·m, a plated or lubricated screw (K about 0.15) and the top of the torque tolerance give about 1222 N, 47 % above the nominal preload; the full threads of the motor still hold at the worst corner (FOS 1.13).

note_strip_basis.value: Strip check on full threads only: from the engagement length we deduct the screw end (2 pitches, the incomplete thread ISO 4753 allows) and the hole lead-in (0.5 pitch): 1.25 mm. With one pitch only, the worst-corner FOS would be 2.61; with the full allowance it is 1.66. The housing strength is a typical value: the maker's data govern.
note_strip_basis.formula: course decision basis statement; from thread_ded_M3, FOS_strip_M3_1P, FOS_strip_M3

torque_note_M3.value: TIGHTEN MOTOR SCREWS M3 TO 0.5 N·m ±10% (SAMPLE MOTOR DATA; THE MOTOR MAKER'S VALUE GOVERNS)

m3alt_flange_engD_min.formula: ISO 7380-2 flanged button head M3 x 6 (flange replaces the washer): least engagement / 3 mm at the tolerance limits (gross)

m3alt_flange_runout_min.formula: ISO 7380-2 flanged button head M3 x 6 (flange replaces the washer): least run-out at the tolerance limits (rule >= 1)

m3alt_flange_FOS_strip.formula: ISO 7380-2 flanged button head M3 x 6 (flange replaces the washer): strip FOS at the worst corner, full threads (gate strip_gate)

m3alt_flange_check.formula: ISO 7380-2 flanged button head M3 x 6 (flange replaces the washer): run-out >= 1 and strip gate at every corner

route_thick_engD_M3_min.spoken: zero point seven times the diameter

route_thick_FOS_strip_min.formula: route (a): strip FOS at the worst corner, full threads (gate strip_gate); M3 x 8 bottoms (information)

route_thick_strip_check.formula: route (a): strip FOS at the worst corner >= strip_gate (information)

slip_res.formula: 4 x mu x preload_M3 (four M3 motor screws, one friction face each)

slip_margin.formula: slip_res / F_design (static, at full preload; preload can drop in service - Ep 22)

bolt_T_pct_preload.formula: bolt_T / preload_M5: load tension as % of preload

note_heel_pivot.value: Tipping about the heel is the least conservative pivot: prying can raise the bolt tension several times; here the load tension (7.5 N) is about 0.2 % of the preload, so the conclusion holds.

note_motor_weight.value: Motor weight 3.5 N, about 12 % of F_design, acts at right angles to F and is neglected: this understates stress and bolt load (non-conservative): it would add about 24 % (+1.81 N) to the upper-bolt load, still far below preload; note it for the reviewer.

arm_motor_weight.formula: a + T/2: motor centre from datum A, far end of the Rev A travel

arm_motor_weight_revB.formula: a - T/2 + T_revB: motor centre from datum A, far end of the Rev B travel (worst)

M_motor_weight.formula: motor_weight x arm_motor_weight: about the M5 bolt rows (horizontal axis), Rev A; parallel to the bend line, so no moment about the bend
M_motor_weight.spoken: one hundred and fifty-four newton millimetres

M_motor_weight_revB.spoken: one hundred and sixty-one newton millimetres

bolt_T_motor_weight.formula: M_motor_weight x2 / (2 (x1^2 + x2^2)), tipping about the lower flange edge, x1 = drw_ted_hole_edge, x2 = x1 + hole_pat_BC: added per upper bolt, Rev A

zone_round_gain_pct.formula: (pi/2 - 1) x 100: area of a round position zone over the square inscribed in it, minus 1 (Ep14 S05)

perp_bend_drop.formula: perp_seat_len x tan(tol_bend_angle): how far the motor seat end moves for the full bend-angle tolerance (Ep14 S12_1; spoken about 1.1)
perp_bend_drop.spoken: one point one three five millimetres

M_motor_weight_revA.formula: motor_weight x arm_motor_weight: about the M5 bolt rows, Rev A (Ep 04)
M_motor_weight_revA.spoken: one hundred and fifty-four newton millimetres

note_motor_weight_moment.value: Motor weight: about 154 N.mm about the bolt rows, in another plane; it adds about 24 % to the upper-bolt load - still far below preload, so the conclusion holds (Ep 08 checks it).
note_motor_weight_moment.formula: fix round 01 A15 (Rev A, Ep 04); from M_motor_weight_revA, bolt_T_motor_weight_pct_revA

bolt_T_motor_torque.formula: T_motor_peak x 1000 x x2 / (2 (x1^2 + x2^2)): added per bolt on one row by the motor reaction torque at peak torque (about the shaft axis, same axis as M_motor_weight; sign follows the drive direction)

bolt_T_worst_all.formula: bolt_T + bolt_T_motor_weight_revB + bolt_T_motor_torque: worst upper bolt with the belt moment, the motor weight (Rev B travel end) and the motor reaction torque at peak torque all adding (Ep 08)

note_motor_reaction_torque.value: Motor reaction torque: the motor body reacts the drive torque (up to 0.45 N.m, SAMPLE) about the shaft axis, in another plane than F; it is not drawn in the Ep 04 FBD. It adds up to about 5.29 N on one bolt row (about 0.13 % of preload), so it errs unsafe but the conclusion holds (Ep 08 checks it).
note_motor_reaction_torque.formula: FIX_ENG Ep04 S-4; from T_motor_peak, bolt_T_motor_torque, preload_M5

note_crash_inertia.formula: fix round 01 A16 (ENG LEAD S2): F_stall = T_motor_peak / r is the quasi-static stall value; a crash at speed adds rotor and pulley inertia

note_nominal_stress.value: Net-section stress is a nominal stress: the peaks at the slot ends (Ep 06) are not included; acceptable for a static yield check in a ductile metal, not for fatigue.

note_K_dry.value: K = 0.2 assumes dry, unlubricated threads; coated or lubricated screws often have a lower K, which gives more preload at the same torque, so use the coating or screw maker's torque table.

note_M3_motor_limit.value: The motor maker's maximum screw torque and preload govern the M3 motor screws: the 833 N preload is illustrative and must not exceed that limit; put the datasheet torque on the assembly note.

note_lever_arms.value: p is measured from the motor mounting face; the exact lever arm to the motor-flange mid-plane is p - t/2 (18.75 mm), so M = F p is about 6.7 % high (conservative).

note_tilt_model.value: Simplified model, errs both ways. Makes the tilt bigger (conservative): the mounting-flange term is an upper bound (propped at the heel, no help from face contact); M = F p overstates the mid-plane moment by about 6.7 %. Makes it smaller (non-conservative): the motor body and its screws are rigid (no joint or flange compliance); the motor-shaft estimate takes the bearings as rigid; the motor weight (12 % of F_design) is neglected. The slot zone is included at its net section. PDS R11 stays open until it is confirmed by test: measured shaft tilt at F_design, motor at the Rev B far end, at most 0.25 deg (R11 open until the tilt test).
note_tilt_model.formula: course decision / from M_conserv_pct, motor_weight_pct, tilt_limit

slot_fit_allowed_plated.spoken: zero point two seven six millimetres

plating_basis_note.value: The supplier allows for plating; the designer checks the drawing size. Note 4: dimensions apply after plating (the sheet thickness is the exception: 2.5 ±0.12 before plating). So the fits are checked on the drawing sizes: Ø5.5 ±0.1 gives 5.4 - 5 = 0.4 available against 0.3 used (Ø0.2 + Ø0.1), 0.1 spare; the M3 slot 3.4 ±0.1 gives 3.3 - 3 = 0.3, the 0.2 slot zone uses 0.2 and 0.1 is left for the motor screw pattern. The supplier cuts larger to make room for the zinc (8-12 µm per wall): hole 5.424-5.616, slot 3.324-3.516 (drawing limits + 2 x maximum zinc / + 2 x minimum zinc). If the plater does not hold the minimum inside holes, the upper cut limit is the drawing maximum. Never subtract the plating again from a drawing size.
plating_basis_note.formula: course decision (4); from hole_M5, tol_laser, d_M5, tol_laser_pos, tol_tapped_pos, m3_slot, zinc_um, zinc_um_max, t_steel, t_tol (= stack_*, slot_fit_*, laser_cut_* keys)

drw_ted_hole_edge.formula: (b - hole_pat_BC) / 2: BASIC (boxed) dimension from the flange side edge to the datum-B hole column; replaces the reference (10)

drw_ted_B_slot_centre.formula: hole_pat_BC / 2: BASIC (boxed) dimension from the datum-B axis to the slot-pattern centre plane (= flange centre plane); the boxed m3_pat is symmetric about it and the pilot slot sits on it (TED 0)

drw_ted_B_slot_row.formula: |drw_ted_hole_edge - (b - m3_pat)/2|: BASIC distance from the datum-B axis to the near M3 slot row (outboard of B); equivalent to drw_ted_B_slot_centre

hole_edge_lmc.formula: drw_ted_hole_edge - (hole_M5 + tol_laser)/2: material from the flange side edge to the M5 hole at its largest drawing size (nominal position)

ted_chain_check.formula: hole pattern and slot pattern share the flange centre plane: drw_ted_hole_edge + drw_ted_B_slot_centre = b/2 (one open chain, no double dimension)

drw_hole_frame.formula: ACT-103 drawing frame on the M5 hole pattern (course decision (2)): from hole_M5, tol_laser, tol_laser_pos

drw_cz_note.value: CZ (ISO 5458:2018, combined zone): the four Ø0.2 position zones are one pattern, locked to each other at their basic spacings. Without CZ, ISO reads one frame on 4× features as four separate zones (SZ) that can move apart, so the fixed-fastener check and the one-way fit are not protected. ASME Y14.5 reads the same frame as one pattern by default, so the ASME drawing needs no modifier.
drw_cz_note.formula: course decision (2); ISO 5458:2018 5.3 Rule A and 5.4.3 (REVIEW_GDT finding 1); from tol_laser_pos

pilot_dia.formula: input (SAMPLE motor datasheet): pilot boss diameter, largest; the maker wins

tol_gen_m.formula: input: ISO 2768-m linear general tolerance +/-, over 6 up to 30 mm (the pilot slot width)

pilot_slot_min.formula: pilot_slot - tol_gen_m: narrowest pilot slot AS DRAWN (after plating, note 4)

pilot_clear.formula: pilot_slot_min - pilot_dia: total clearance across the slot; rounded down

pilot_clear_side.formula: pilot_clear / 2: clearance per side with everything centred (the reviewer's 0.39 subtracted the plating again)

pilot_slot_pos_max.formula: pilot_clear - M3 slot zone (tol_laser_pos, width) - motor_pat_pos_req (pilot to pattern, diameter): widest pilot-slot position zone that keeps the pilot clear with the screws centred in their slots; rounded down

pos_pilot_slot.formula: input (drawing choice): pilot-slot position zone WIDTH, width only, to A|B|C on the same TEDs as the motor slots (TED 0 to their centre plane)

pilot_slot_pos_margin.formula: pilot_slot_pos_max - pos_pilot_slot: spare width in the pilot clearance stack; rounded down

pilot_slot_pos_check.formula: pos_pilot_slot <= pilot_slot_pos_max: the pilot does not touch the slot, so it does not locate the motor (note 6)

drw_pilot_frame.value: ⌖ | 0.4 | A | B | C (PILOT SLOT, WIDTH ONLY; TED 0 TO THE MOTOR-SLOT CENTRE PLANE)
drw_pilot_frame.formula: ACT-103 drawing frame under the pilot-slot callout (course decision (3)): from pos_pilot_slot

pilot_stack_note.value: Pilot-slot stack (width, drawing sizes after plating): 23 - 0.2 = 22.8 slot minimum, less the Ø22 pilot = 0.8 (0.4 per side). The motor-slot zone takes 0.2 and the motor's pattern-to-pilot tolerance Ø0.1, so the pilot-slot zone may be up to 0.5 wide; the drawing gives 0.4, 0.1 spare. The screw float in the motor slots is adjustment, not error: the motor is clamped by its screws and the pilot only has to clear.

eco001_root_cause.value: Root cause: motor-screw preload drops in service (short M3 grip, about 3 mm of sheet and washer between plated faces, so a few micrometres of embedding lose much of the preload) and the motor slips in its slots; contributing: belt stretch uses up the travel.

ga12_verdict.value: A supplier offers one lot of 12 GA steel (2.657 mm; gauge band 2.5-2.81) for the 2.5 ±0.12 mm on the drawing. Strength passes (smallest FOS 8.11) and tilt passes (0.1 deg). The M3 x 6 motor screws fail the quick 1D screen (0.95D), so the stack is checked at every tolerance corner on full threads only: at the gauge nominal the strip FOS is 1.61 against 1.5, but the top of the gauge band (2.81 mm) would give only 1.42; every gate still passes up to 2.74 mm. It is still off the drawing (2.62 mm max), so it needs a deviation. Deviation ACCEPTED for this lot only, on one condition: at incoming inspection every PART measured over the plating (micrometer on the motor flange, 3 points) is 2.77 mm or less, the plating allowance being inside that limit (parts above it are rejected); if agreed, every sheet may instead be measured bare at source before laser cutting, 2.74 mm or less; lot number and quantity recorded, M3 x 6 and washer unchanged (M3 x 8 would bottom), quality approves. A 13 GA lot (2.278 mm; band 2.15-2.4) fails on thread below the tip: at its thin end it leaves 0.86 mm, under our 1 mm rule. The drawing stays "2.5 ±0.12 mm before plating"; never specify a gauge alone.

bend_static_tilt.formula: as-made bend-angle error allowed by the drawing (tol_bend_angle); it rotates the motor seat about the same axis as the load tilt

bend_budget_check.formula: bend_static_tilt <= misalign_budget (expected FAIL: the bend tolerance alone is about 11 times the static budget)

tol_bend_best.formula: input: press-brake bend angle, +/- with active angle measurement and crowning (specialised; typical published value)

mis_req_text.value: Belt alignment, open-ended belt clamped to the carriage: the belt has three spans - drive pulley to carriage clamp, idler pulley to carriage clamp, and the return span between the pulleys. In the steering plane (rotation about the vertical axis, parallel to the ACT-103 bend line) the belt-entry angle at each pulley, in every span, is at most 0.25 deg in operation, static + elastic. Each clamp travels along the rail, so both pulleys AND both clamps are set to the rail (the carriage travel), not only to each other; the drive-to-idler difference is also limited (return span). Twist about the belt direction does not change the entry angle; it is checked (mis_twist_strain), not budgeted.
mis_req_text.formula: R11 requirement, open-ended carriage belt; belt-entry-angle wording per synchronous-belt installation guidance (alignment_study.md R2)

adj_range_drive.formula: input: ACT-101 drive end block yaw adjustment range +/- (design requirement)

act101_dowel_span.formula: input: ACT-101 pivot dowel to ACT-111 eccentric centre (design value, illustrative)

ecc_e.formula: input: ACT-111 eccentric pin eccentricity (design value)

pulley_x.formula: input: pivot dowel to drive pulley axis along the rail (layout value, illustrative)

read_r.formula: reading radius on the pulley flange face: the two indicator points are read_r either side of the shaft centre (set_sweep / 2)

mis_p_accept_mm.formula: acceptance, EACH pulley against the rail: indicator change over set_sweep (two points 8 mm either side of the shaft centre, mean of two half-turn positions)
mis_p_accept_mm.spoken: zero point zero zero five millimetres

mis_p_accept.formula: mis_p_accept_mm as an angle: atan(r2_accept_mm / set_sweep)
mis_p_accept.spoken: zero point zero one eight degrees

mis_c_accept_mm.formula: acceptance, EACH belt clamp (ACT-107) against the rail: indicator change over clamp_sweep along its reference side face
mis_c_accept_mm.spoken: zero point zero zero five millimetres

mis_c_accept.formula: mis_c_accept_mm as an angle: atan(r2_accept_mm / clamp_sweep)
mis_c_accept.spoken: zero point zero one four degrees

mis_d_accept_mm.formula: acceptance, return span: drive-pulley mean minus idler-pulley mean (with sign), over set_sweep
mis_d_accept_mm.spoken: zero point zero zero five millimetres

mis_d_accept.spoken: zero point zero one eight degrees

mis_u_res.formula: uncertainty item, each pulley: indicator reading error, 2 x dti_res_r2 / set_sweep (two readings; resolution and local indication error over the few micrometres used)
mis_u_res.spoken: zero point zero zero seven two degrees

mis_u_flat.formula: uncertainty item, each pulley: flange-face flatness, flange_flat / set_sweep (the half-turn mean cancels wobble and every odd-order face form; the belt turns the pulley during the sweep, so even-order form such as a saddle remains: counted in full)
mis_u_flat.spoken: zero point zero one zero seven degrees

mis_u_travel.formula: uncertainty item, each pulley: carriage running straightness over the sweep, travel_straight / set_sweep
mis_u_travel.spoken: zero point zero zero three six degrees

mis_u_pulley.formula: measurement uncertainty, EACH pulley: mis_u_res + mis_u_flat + mis_u_travel (worst-case sum)
mis_u_pulley.spoken: zero point zero two two degrees

mis_u_pulley_rss.formula: information: the same items added statistically (root sum of squares); the budget uses the worst-case sum
mis_u_pulley_rss.spoken: zero point zero one three degrees

mis_u_clamp.formula: measurement uncertainty, EACH clamp: (2 x dti_res_r2 + clamp_face_par + travel_straight) / clamp_sweep (worst-case sum)
mis_u_clamp.spoken: zero point zero one eight degrees

mis_s2_total.spoken: zero point zero seven one degrees

mis_budget_basis.value: The R11 budget is for steady running at the working load (F_max). Start-stop peaks at F_design = 1.25 x F_max are momentary: the drive span then reaches about 0.274 deg for an instant; the 1.25 factor is a strength and tilt-gate factor and is not inside the alignment budget.

mis_drv_range.formula: ACT-101 yaw range from ACT-111: atan(ecc_e / act101_dowel_span)

mis_drv_range_check.formula: mis_drv_range >= adj_range_drive >= mis_drv_static_worst (every conforming drive side can be set)

mis_ecc_turn.formula: eccentric turn that moves the drive pulley by one acceptance, mid-range: mis_p_accept / (ecc_e / act101_dowel_span) (fine; set, torque, re-measure)

mis_drv_shift_max.formula: largest axial shift of the drive pulley when ACT-101 turns: pulley_x x tan(mis_drv_static_worst); re-centre the pulley on its shaft (assembly step 1)

mis_opt_slot_text.value: Slotting the ACT-103 holes (or the motor slots) cannot correct the yaw: a part bolted flat on a face can only turn in the plane of that face. The ACT-103 mounting flange lies on the ACT-101 end face, so slots turn it about the belt direction (twist plane), not about the bend line; the motor turns in its seat only about its own shaft. It would also change ACT-103.
mis_opt_slot_text.formula: R2 option (b): physics of a bolted face

mis_opt_slot_check.formula: option (b) slotted ACT-103 or motor mounting corrects the steering plane (FAIL: wrong plane, and ACT-103 is frozen)

mis_opt_wedge_dt.formula: option (c) wedge shim between ACT-103 and ACT-101: thickness difference across the M5 rows (y2 - L1) for mis_drv_static_worst

mis_opt_wedge_step.formula: option (c): shim step that one acceptance needs, (y2 - L1) x tan(mis_p_accept)
mis_opt_wedge_step.spoken: zero point zero zero nine four millimetres

mis_opt_peel_step.formula: option (c): angle step of one peel-shim lamination under one M5 row, atan(peel_lam / (y2 - L1))
mis_opt_peel_step.spoken: zero point zero nine five degrees

mis_opt_wedge_check.formula: option (c) shim steps fine enough for mis_p_accept (FAIL; shims also add faying faces to the bracket friction joint, the ECO-001 root cause)

mis_opt_noidl_total.formula: option: drop the ACT-102 adjustment (idler as toleranced): return span = mis_elastic + mis_p_accept + mis_u_pulley + mis_idl_static_worst
mis_opt_noidl_total.spoken: zero point three zero five degrees

mis_opt_noidl_check.formula: idler without adjustment meets R11 in the return span (FAIL: keep the ACT-102 adjustment)

mis_twist_worst.formula: twist plane, drive pulley, as toleranced (upper bound): bend-line skew atan(2 tol_across_bend / b) + M5 hole clearance turn (hole_M5 - d_M5) / (y2 - L1) + mis_s_motor + one pulley

mis_twist_strain.formula: belt edge strain from that twist over span_min: (belt_width / 2)^2 x (twist / span_min)^2 / 2 (second order; no steering)

mis_twist_note.value: Twist about the belt direction (the second angular plane) turns the pulley axis up or down, but the belt still runs in the pulley plane, so the entry angle does not change. Worst case as toleranced the drive pulley twists about 1.7 deg; over the shortest span that adds only a few millionths of edge strain to the belt. It is not budgeted; the tracking run at both stroke ends confirms it.
mis_twist_note.formula: R2 twist plane; from mis_twist_worst, mis_twist_strain

act101_adjust_req.value: ACT-101 drive end block (Rev A; ECO-001 Rev B adds only the M4 holes): turns about the dowel nearer the bracket (COTS-214, fit as now); the second dowel hole becomes a slot on the line to the pivot, engaged by the ACT-111 eccentric pin in ACT-108; yaw range at least ±1.5 deg (eccentricity 1.1 mm at 40 mm gives ±1.57 deg). The four M5 clamp holes in ACT-108 under ACT-101 are opened so the block can turn (size at the ACT-101/ACT-108 detail), with large washers. After setting: torque the four M5, lock ACT-111 with its M4 nut, measure again. This turns the end face, ACT-103, the motor and the drive pulley together, inside the machined chain; ACT-103 is unchanged.
act101_adjust_req.formula: design requirement for the ACT-101 Rev A and ACT-108 drawings; from adj_range_drive, ecc_e, act101_dowel_span

act111_desc.value: ACT-111 Eccentric adjusting pin: steel; plain shank turning in the ACT-108 bore, eccentric head (offset 1.1 mm) in the ACT-101 slot, hex socket 2 mm and M4 thread at the lower end, locked by an M4 nut (COTS-220) under ACT-108 (illustrative; sizes at the detail)

mis_flat_accept_mm.spoken: zero point zero zero three millimetres

mis_rep_spread_mm.formula: repeatability check: three repeats of each mean must agree within 2 x dti_res_r2
mis_rep_spread_mm.spoken: zero point zero zero two millimetres

drw_note_alignment.value: THE MOTOR-SEAT ANGLE (BEND 90° ±1°, ⊥ 1.2 | A) IS NOT THE BELT-ALIGNMENT CONTROL. AT ASSEMBLY EACH PULLEY IS SET PARALLEL TO THE RAIL: THE DRIVE PULLEY BY TURNING THE ACT-101 END BLOCK ON ITS PIVOT DOWEL (ECCENTRIC PIN ACT-111), THE IDLER BY THE ACT-102 ADJUSTMENT (ASSEMBLY NOTE: BELT ALIGNMENT).
drw_note_alignment.formula: ACT-103 drawing note (Rev A, Rev B), R2 wording; from tol_bend_angle, perp_motor_seat

act102_adjust_req.value: ACT-102 idler end block: idler shaft seat adjustable in angle about the vertical axis (the steering plane), range at least ±1.5 deg; set with one M3 push screw and locked with two M3 screws; the idler is set to the RAIL (not to the drive pulley), then the drive-minus-idler difference is checked; the locked seat carries the belt load without slip and is taken as rigid in the budget (non-conservative; the R11 test measures the total).
act102_adjust_req.formula: design requirement for the ACT-102 drawing, R2 wording; from adj_range

asm_alignment_step.value: BELT ALIGNMENT (PDS R11; open-ended belt: every part the belt touches is set to the rail). 0. On receipt: each pulley's outer flange face flat within 0.003 mm over the reading zone (pulley on a surface plate, indicator on a stand), or reject. 1. Fit the motor, both flanged pulleys and the belt; tension the belt to the installation value; move a pulley along its shaft if needed so the belt runs centred between the flanges at both stroke ends. 2. Clamps: digital indicator (0.001 mm) on a magnetic base on ACT-108, stylus on the reference side face of a belt clamp (ACT-107); move the carriage 20 mm; the change must be 0.005 mm or less. If not, loosen the clamp screws, turn the clamp, tighten, measure again. Both clamps. 3. Drive pulley: indicator on the carriage, stylus on the outer flange face on the line through the shaft centre parallel to the rail; read at the two points 8 mm either side of the centre (16 mm of carriage travel; the belt turns the pulley as the carriage moves). Then move the carriage on by half a pulley turn (30 mm = 10 teeth), move the indicator base back by the same distance on the carriage and repeat; the mean of the two changes is the pulley's angle to the rail (face wobble cancels) and must be 0.005 mm or less. If not, in this order (set, snug, check, torque, re-check): set - the four ACT-101 M5 screws just loose enough to slide, turn the ACT-111 eccentric until the reading is in; snug - the four M5 screws lightly, cross pattern; check - read again, correct with ACT-111 if needed; torque - the four M5 screws, cross pattern, and lock the ACT-111 M4 nut; re-check - measure again; outside, back to set. 4. Idler pulley: the same; adjust with the ACT-102 push screw (loosen and re-tighten its two locking screws). 5. Drive mean minus idler mean, read with the same sign convention: 0.005 mm or less. 6. Repeat steps 3-5 three times; each mean must repeat within 0.002 mm. 7. Run 10 full strokes: the belt rides no flange and stays centred at both stroke ends. Record every mean on the assembly record.
asm_alignment_step.formula: assembly note (assembly record and Ep 20 inspection plan), R2 method; from dti_res_r2, set_sweep, clamp_sweep, r2_accept_mm, flange_flat

insp_alignment_line.value: Belt alignment record: clamp 1, clamp 2 (20 mm sweep), drive pulley, idler pulley (16 mm, mean of two half-turn positions): each change 0.005 mm or less; drive minus idler 0.005 mm or less; 3 repeats within 0.002 mm; pulley flange flatness 0.003 mm (receipt); tracking run 10 strokes. Gauge: digital indicator 0.001 mm on a magnetic base.
insp_alignment_line.formula: Inspection_Card / Ep 20 record line; from the R2 acceptance keys

pds_r11_text.value: Belt alignment: belt-entry angle at each pulley in every span (drive and idler to their carriage clamps, and the return span between the pulleys), in operation at the working load, at most 0.25 deg (synchronous-belt guidance; the belt maker wins). Shares: bracket + motor shaft (elastic, drive pulley only) by design, bracket tilt at the design load at most 0.25 deg; every static error set out at assembly by setting each pulley and each belt clamp to the rail within 0.005 mm over its sweep. Verified by the tilt test (total).
pds_r11_text.formula: PDS R11 wording, R2 (replaces "between the drive and idler pulleys"); from tilt_guide, tilt_limit, r2_accept_mm

mis_verdict.value: R11, open-ended belt: the belt-entry angle at each pulley, in every span, must stay within 0.25 deg. Each clamp rides the rail, so each pulley and each clamp is set to the rail, not only to the other pulley. Elastic 0.162 deg (bracket 0.092 + motor shaft 0.07, working load, drive pulley only). As toleranced the drive pulley is up to 1.28 deg off the rail (mostly the bend), so the drive side needs its own adjustment: ACT-101 turns on one dowel, set by the ACT-111 eccentric (±1.57 deg); slots in ACT-103 turn it in the wrong plane, and wedge shims cannot step finely enough. The idler keeps its ACT-102 adjustment (without it the return span reaches 0.305 deg). Each pulley and clamp is set within 0.005 mm over its sweep with a 0.001 mm indicator; with flange flatness, reading and travel errors: drive pulley 0.233 deg, margin 0.017 deg (6 %); idler pulley 0.223 deg, margin 0.027 deg (10 %). Simplified model, steady running; R11 stays open until the tilt test, which measures the total.

scorecard_strength.value: Strength (PDS R4): released 2.5 mm steel, smallest FOS 7.18 on the specified minimum yield (gate 2.5): PASS; crash/stall smallest FOS 4.57 (gate 1.5): PASS.

scorecard_stiffness.value: Stiffness (PDS R5, R11): shaft tilt 0.1 / 0.12 deg at Rev A / Rev B (limit 0.25); with the motor shaft at the working load 0.088 deg (35 %) is left for every static misalignment, including the as-made bend angle, which is set out at assembly by setting each pulley to the rail (drive pulley 0.233 deg in its worst span after setting); pulley movement 0.05 mm (limit 0.5): PASS on a simplified model; to be confirmed by test (open action): R11 open until the tilt test.

study_o1_tilt_A.formula: option 1, 2.0 mm steel (thinner option; superseded, not released): bracket tilt, design load, Rev A; simplified model, errs both ways: gross section elsewhere, net section in slot zone; mounting term upper bound (conservative); motor and screws rigid (non-conservative); confirm by test (PDS R11)

study_o1_tilt_B.formula: option 1, 2.0 mm steel (thinner option; superseded, not released): bracket tilt, design load, Rev B
